stories.headline: 'WarshGPT': How Wall Street is adapting to the Fed's new era of communication

stories.headline: Kansas bank becomes second in a week to fail, fourth this year
stories.body: Small Business Bank in Kansas failed on Friday, the second failure in a week and the fourth failure overall in 2026.
